  padj: 0.05
  dpsi: 0.15
  in_file: "test_files/diffsplice_Whole_Blood_vs_AML.tsv"

---

This notebook takes Wilcoxon test statistics and dPSI values for query and reference groups chosen in `scripts/06-diffsplice_calculation.R` as input. 
After filtering for splice events with user-defined padj and dPSI thresholds, this notebook performs over-representation analysis (ORA) on the parent genes of the filtered splice events.

Caveats:

- The input to this notebook is currently the AML (stranded) vs. Whole Blood (unstranded) diffsplice results so doesn't reflect the biological comparison we want to make for the manuscript.

## Setup

Load libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
```

Define directory and file paths

```{r}
## directories
# repo root
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)

## files
# whole blood vs AML splice results with gene name, median PSI, diffsplice dpsi, and p-adj columns
diffsplice_results_file <- file.path(repo_root, params$in_file)

# output ORA results
out_ora_file <- file.path(repo_root, params$out_ora_file)
out_sig_diffsplice_file <- file.path(repo_root, params$out_sig_diffsplice_file)
```

Read in files

```{r}
diffsplice_results <- readr::read_tsv(diffsplice_results_file) 
```

## ORA

Obtain msigdb gene sets relevant to humans
```{r}
hs_msigdb_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
```

### Retrieve gene lists from splice results for ORA

Background genes (`detected_genes`) are all genes with non-NA (numeric) PSI values quantified for at least min_samples in the reference and query groups. 
In the test data used here, min_samples is 5.

```{r}
detected_genes <- diffsplice_results |>
  # remove NA p values, as they are present in the diffsplice data frame
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_adj)) |>
  # extract gene names column for ORA
  dplyr::pull(gene_names) |>
  # take unique set of parent genes
  unique()
```

Filter for differential splicing results within padj and significance thresholds and obtain the diffsplice gene list

```{r}
# filter for significant diffsplice events
filtered_diffsplice_results <- diffsplice_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    p_adj < params$padj,
    abs(dPSI) > params$dpsi
  ) |>
  # rank significant diff splice events by abs(dPSI)
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(dPSI)))

# obtain vector of significant diffsplice parent genes
diffsplice_genes <- unique(filtered_diffsplice_results$gene_names)
```

### ORA on significantly differentially spliced genes

For a first pass, I am not filtering for specific gene sets and applying a more stringent p filter.
In an earlier iteration, I tried to perform ORA on the splicing gene sets defined by `splice_ids`, 
but no set was enriched even when `pvalueCutoff` = 1.

```{r}
ora_result <- enricher(
  gene = diffsplice_genes, 
  pvalueCutoff = 0.01,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  universe = detected_genes,
  TERM2GENE = dplyr::select(
    hs_msigdb_df,
    gs_name,
    gene_symbol
  )
)

```

## Plot ORA results

Plot overlapping genes in each gene set with an upset plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 11

upsetplot(ora_result) +
  ggtitle("Overlap of genes in ORA gene sets for AML vs Whole Blood")
```

Plot gene set gene count and significance from ORA: dot plot of gene set gene abundance (gene ratio) and ORA p values

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 8

dotplot(ora_result)
```
## Write outputs to file

```{r write_output}
readr::write_tsv(as.data.frame(ora_result), out_ora_file)
readr::write_tsv(diffsplice_results, out_sig_diffsplice_file)
```
